name: cypress-mini-shop-submission
description: Frontend-only Cypress Mini Shop with parallel E2E specs and Mochawesome reporting

scripts.test:parallel: node scripts/clean-reports.cjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --max-processes 2 --names auth,products,add-product,flaky-load "node scripts/cypress-run.cjs run --spec cypress/e2e/auth/login.cy.js" "node scripts/cypress-run.cjs run --spec cypress/e2e/dashboard/products.cy.js" "node scripts/cypress-run.cjs run --spec cypress/e2e/dashboard/add-product.cy.js" "node scripts/cypress-run.cjs run --spec cypress/e2e/dashboard/flaky-load.cy.js"
scripts.test:submission: npm run test:parallel && npm run report:merge
